generation.template: A hand-painted ancient memory scene, made with opaque poster colors on paper in the style of the reference. {setting} Use visible, restrained brushwork, one natural upper-left warm light source, muted brown ochre balanced by sage green and cool blue-green shadows. Readable everyday objects and plausible architecture; calm right third and lower edge for dynamic UI. Any people are small back-view or side-view figures in plain ancient clothing. No readable text, letters, numbers, symbols, UI, frames, ornate gold patterns, halos, sparkles, self-luminous objects, lens flare, bokeh or depth-of-field blur. The reference supplies brushwork, color and lighting only: create a new ancient place, never reproduce the modern shop.
generation.target_size_prompt: Landscape16:9. Produce the actual maximum native landscape resolution available, preferably2560x1440; retain the real output dimensions. Do not label an upscaled file as native.

eras.setting: An old river ferry landing: worn wooden steps, a simple tied ferry boat, reeds and a small group of plain baskets, with one distant traveler seen from behind.
A village bridge being repaired: believable stone supports, timber planks, a few grouped ropes and hand tools, with two distant workers seen from the side.
An ancient medicinal garden beside a modest herb shed: grouped clay pots, low herb beds, a plain drying rack and one distant gardener seen from behind.
